narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>For the highest common factor, I take the most copies of each prime.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Five is only in bag one, so the second number has no five to divide.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A common factor must divide both numbers, so that slip takes too much.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Fewest copies of the shared primes give the highest common factor.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Most copies of every prime give the lowest common multiple.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Bag one holds two, three, three and five. Bag two holds three, five and seventeen. Find both answers.
